_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); machinery and engines signals

pit_profile.why: 'Caterpillar is the leader in construction and mining equipment, and diesel and natural gas engines and industrial gas turbines in our size range' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1); 'Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets'; 'Our results of operations are materially affected by the conditions in the global economy generally and various capital markets.', 'The energy and mining industries are major users of our machines and engines.', 'Decisions to purchase our machines and engines are dependent upon performance of these industries.' and 'The rates of infrastructure spending, housing starts and commercial construction play a significant role in our results.' (Item 1A): demand that depends on the economy and the industries served is not earnings that are the cycle (the RCL rule), so DURABLE; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: 'Caterpillar is the leader in construction and mining equipment, and diesel and natural gas engines and industrial gas turbines in our size range' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1); 'Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets'; 'Our results of operations are materially affected by the conditions in the global economy generally and various capital markets.', 'The energy and mining industries are major users of our machines and engines.', 'Decisions to purchase our machines and engines are dependent upon performance of these industries.' and 'The rates of infrastructure spending, housing starts and commercial construction play a significant role in our results.' (Item 1A): demand that depends on the economy and the industries served is not earnings that are the cycle (the RCL rule), so DURABLE; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.79x; +79% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.62; conservative 2yr +15%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -61.5%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +26.2%/yr (FY10 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.2%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +60.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CAT (retrospective, 2010-08-20) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.79x (91.3% downside to Bear $6 / +51.0% upside to Bull $104) | Adj composite 3.00 vs market 2.38: gap +0.62 [UNDERVALUED] | +79% above the EPP floor $38 (11x FY10E $3.50) | Conservative 2-yr case: +15.1% total (+7.5%/yr) | At 19.7x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $91 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Machinery sales +55.2% in Q2 2010, forward revenues +20.4-29.6% (FY10 sales and revenues guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
